run_findings.keycloak_network_revocation_gate: Current Keycloak main ae1a37058febedf3fe89e6ff3bc3b0f20176a43f TokenManager rejects tokens issued before realm/client/user not-before and rejects explicit revoked token IDs. AccessTokenIntrospectionProvider composes not-before, active, revoked-token, session, user and audience checks before active=true. Per-request introspection can therefore implement a network REVOCATION_AWARE_REQUEST_GATE.
run_findings.keycloak_push_freshness_boundary: Pushed not-before is epoch-like but a client relying on a local pushed copy must prove update freshness. Missed/delayed push remains REVOCATION_STATE_FRESHNESS_UNPROVED; direct request-time introspection has a stronger current-state boundary.
run_findings.keycloak_mcp_missing_surface: Current Keycloak MCP guide lists latest MCP 2026-07-28 as only partially supported without OAuth Resource Indicators. Capability detection must separate working OAuth/audience/introspection from missing current MCP Resource Indicators surface.
